about: Change log, like git log: one entry per set of changes, newest first. Only what changed, which files, and why. Plans, research and requirements live in PRD.md.

entries.summary: Convert the PRD from JSON to Markdown
entries.why: User asked for the PRD as Markdown. All content carried over, including research notes; milestones and the problem statement updated. AGENTS.md now points to PRD.md.

entries.summary: Pass clippy; style wrapped report lines one by one
entries.why: Collapsed two nested ifs into let-chains (stable since Rust 1.88, the MSRV). Dimmed 'Fix:' text is now styled per line, so pagers and the SVG screenshot keep it dim after a wrap. cargo fmt applied.

entries.summary: Add README, assets, scripts and project docs
entries.why: README with a real pip3 screenshot, a leaderboard of 18 well-known CLIs, a checks table generated from the binary, CI and agent usage, safety notes and an FAQ. Scripts regenerate the screenshot and leaderboard.

entries.summary: Make log.json change-only; add agent instructions
entries.why: User asked for log.json to record only changes, and for every future session to read prd.json and log.json first. Research notes moved from log.json to prd.json under 'research'.

entries.summary: Add GitHub Action, CI, release workflow, install script, issue templates
entries.why: Composite Action writes a Markdown job summary and enforces min-score. CI runs tests on Linux and macOS, builds on Windows, lints, checks MSRV, and runs mannerly on itself.

entries.summary: Add agent skill and Claude Code plugin manifests
entries.why: Lets coding agents run mannerly --json on the CLIs they build and apply framework-specific fixes (clap, cobra/flag, argparse/click, commander/yargs, shell).

entries.summary: Add integration tests with fixture CLIs
entries.why: 12 end-to-end tests: a polite tool scores 100, a rude one is caught, Ctrl-C ignoring fails, plus exit codes, badge, markdown, --skip/--explain/--list-checks. All 22 tests (10 unit, 12 integration) pass.
User asked for a JSON log and a JSON PRD. Both are excluded from the published crate.

entries.summary: Fix false results found by running on real tools
entries.why: Resolve relative command paths (runs use a temp cwd). PTY now answers terminal queries (OSC 10/11/12, CSI 6n, DA1/DA2, DECRQM) so gh and other TUIs don't hang. Ctrl-C now tries Ctrl-C, Ctrl-C, Ctrl-D so REPLs pass. Timeouts scale with startup time; default 10s. 'Example usage:' counts as a usage line. Help-content checks skip when --help fails. Removed help.narrow (no signal). Distinct glyph for empty bar segments. Hidden MANNERLY_DUMP=1 debug output.

entries.summary: Create mannerly: Lighthouse for command-line tools
entries.why: Rust CLI that runs a command via pipes, a closed stdout and a real PTY, scores 28 checks 0-100, and prints terminal, JSON, Markdown or an SVG badge.
